Ville

An area with wooden crates and a recycler.

Activités

Search crates, then recycle suitable items into crafting resources.

Principaux gains

Crates can contain Scrap, water, tools, armour and components; contents vary.

Risques

Other players may search the same area, and the recycler makes noise.

Recycler

There is a recycler here. It breaks down recyclable items and makes noise while running.
